senses.sense_definition: A traditional medical practice involving the insertion of thin needles into specific points on the body to relieve pain or treat various health conditions.

examples.text: Many patients seek <w>acupuncture</w> to help manage chronic back pain.
The doctor recommended <w>acupuncture</w> as a pain relief method for her migraines.

senses.sense_definition: To perform the medical procedure of acupuncture on a patient.

examples.text: The specialist will <w>acupunctured</w> the patient to alleviate muscle tension.
